name: Music Player
description: Compact album-art music player card with sliding covers, scrubbable progress bar, transport controls, animated equalizer bars and a slide-up queue panel.
contents: Cover carousel with track title, artist and track counter
Progress bar with elapsed and total time
Slide-up queue list with cover, title, artist and duration
behavior: Plays audio from each song's audio URL with autoplay to the next track
Covers slide horizontally when the track changes
Progress bar can be clicked or dragged to seek
Queue panel slides up over the card from the list button
editableByProps: Songs, covers, audio sources, titles, artists and durations
Accent, card and queue colors, corner radius, slide duration

needsCodeEdit.change: Change card width or cover height
needsCodeEdit.where: w-[340px] card wrapper and h-[300px] cover block

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Uses Bricolage Grotesque and Inter through next/font/google, so it requires Next.js
Text and control tints are fixed white-on-dark
